text:
Type: geometric woven throw blanket
Use: layering on a sofa, chair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, coastal, contemporary
Materials: soft woven fabric, twisted fringe
Colors: ivory, light cool blue grey
Shape: rectangular throw, large triangle blocks filled with fine stripes, reversible tones, twisted cream fringe, soft drape
Feel: calm, airy, soft
Goes with: white walls, light wood, pale blue and grey accents; Scandinavian or coastal rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Geo Throw Blanket, Soft and Stylish, 50" x 60", Ivory and Blue
product.description: Varying shades of blue/grey triangles on ivory give this blanket both modern and farmhouse touches. A cotton/acrylic blend makes it soft yet durable to snuggle under for a good night's sleep, or as a drape over a living room chair. 50" x 60" 50% Cotton 50% Acrylic Dry clean for best results Made in Portugal
